content.title: Cathie Wood-backed Solmate scoops up solana in last week's drawdown
content.summary: Cathie Wood's Ark Invest-backed Solmate Infrastructure said on Tuesday it had picked up cryptocurrency solana during last week's sharp pullback in the market for digital assets. Risk-off sentiment hit cryptocurrencies on Friday as Sino-U.S. tensions flared, triggering the sector's biggest wave of leveraged liquidations, market participants said, with solana tumbling nearly 22% in just two days to a two-month low by Saturday. Solmate said it acquired the token for $50 million, a 15% discount to the market price.

content.title: Solana blockchain is set to scale, ethereum isn't: Solmate CEO
content.description:
Digital asset treasury company Solmate — rebranded from Brera Holdings (BREA) — will be shifting its focus to operating on a Solana-based (SOL-USD) blockchain rather than ethereum (ETH-USD).

Solmate founder and CEO Marco Santori, who was recently appointed chief executive, explains why Solana could be a better crypto platform. Also catch Santori's comment on the "gold rush" mentality driving digital asset treasury expansions.

Santori previously served as an advisor to the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and chairman of the Bitcoin Foundation Regulatory Affairs Committee.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination.

content.title: 'Gold rush' mentality is feeding digital asset treasury growth
content.description:
There's been a boom in digital asset treasuries (DAT) while other public companies added cryptocurrencies to their balance sheets. One such company is Brera Holdings (BREA), which is rebranding to Solmate and has received backing from Cathie Wood, whose ARK Invest (ARKK) acquired $49.72 million worth of shares in September.

Solmate founder and CEO Marco Santori — who was recently appointed chief executive — talks more about the company's focus on the Solana (SOL-USD) ecosystem and the growth of digital asset treasury companies.

Santori previously served as an advisor to the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and chairman of the Bitcoin Foundation Regulatory Affairs Committee.
